idea-plugin.name: Vavi Tweaks
idea-plugin.description:
Small tweaks for java editing.
  • Structure view shows junit5 @DisplayName values at right of method (and nested class) names.
  • Clicking a class or an interface in extends/implements highlights the methods overriding or implementing it.
  • Intentions and quick fixes (alt+enter popup, top fix in problem tooltips) are ordered by how often you used them.
  • Markdown editor/preview split follows the "Preview layout" setting (split horizontally is ignored by the ide), and defaults to split horizontally.
  • Folding states of xml files (e.g. pom.xml) are kept when the file is closed and reopened.
